limitations: 52 previously observed cases are development evidence. New validation was frozen before running; authored synthetic labels are not strictly blind.
Query embedding, BM25/RRF ranking and one rerank request are shared within a case. Per-variant latency/usage reuse those measurements; sum actual_accounting only.
Backfill verifies up to 10 candidates before selecting at most 3 accepted chunks. The final chunk budget is equal; verification and final token budgets differ.
Single pass; service caching and network variance remain. Retrieval coverage is not generated answer accuracy or end-to-end agent latency.
Rerank and embedding prices are unknown; costs are partial. Failures are retained.
